description: The minimum burial cover for a power cable by country, voltage and location (open ground, road, pavement; direct or in a raceway for the US and Australia), from the rule the site holds for that country (national rules, HD 603 / HD 620 parts, NEC 2026 Tables 300.7(A) and 305.15(A), IS 1255), with its source and seen level; null with the reason where none was read. Free, deterministic, no LLM.

method.description: direct (default) or raceway (duct or conduit); the US and Australian rules tell them apart.

place.description: field (open ground, default), road or pavement.

u.description: U in kV (1 for 0.6/1 kV, 20 for 12/20 kV) or Uo/U such as "0.6/1".

name: burial_depth
title: Minimum burial depth of a cable by country
